card.name: Linking words before hypotension or hypoglycemia
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "for" or "causes" that come right before an expected adverse-effect term, mostly hypotension, hypoglycemia or heart failure, in drug-label warnings.

modes.label: Of/for before a risk term
modes.description: The word "of" or "for" after nouns like risk, likelihood, development or signs, just ahead of a named effect.
modes.example: with greater risk<< of>> hypoglycemia. Lithium

modes.label: Verb before symptoms
modes.description: A verb such as "causes" or "control" that is followed by symptoms.
modes.example: a dosage just under that which<< causes>> signs of mild postural hypotension

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward naming a particular effect next, but the listed output tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a label names a drop in blood pressure or blood sugar.
